items.title: Delfeayo Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said, “I just wanted to tell you that of all the records we put out on RCA Novus in that period of time, that Pontius Pilate is the one that still stands up.”

ctx.x: There you go. [Marsalis replies.] The only redemption of – it’s a very small redemption – of RCA is that four years ago I saw Steve Backer, who was the executive producer. He saw me at a conference. He says, “Delfeayo.” Then he says, “I’m so glad I saw you.” He said, “I just wanted to tell you that of all the records we put out on RCA Novus in that period of time, that Pontius Pilate is the one that still stands up.” Then he was like, “I wish things had been different.” We looked at each other. It was like –…
